subject: shape-A corpus boundary (335 signed historical cards are not root leaves, by ruling)

payload.statement: Boundary declaration. The 335 cards under /signed/cards/ are the August-2026 shape-A corpus (gspc.measurement-card, body+id envelope, prev-chained). They verify standalone under did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1 via their preimage_rule. They are not leaves of public-root/v1 and never will be: docs/CARD_V0_EVIDENCE_GRAMMAR_2026-09-01.md rules the two corpora do not mix. This card closes the count question by being itself a leaf of the living root: from this leaf onward, every card the estate signs under the current grammar is anchored in the hour it is signed.
